shared-start.title: Your starting point
shared-start.instruction: Face the sample campus walkway, then continue straight.
shared-start.landmark: Look for the entrance sign beside the path.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder showing a campus entrance and a wide path; not an APB photograph.

shared-walkway.title: Along the walkway
shared-walkway.instruction: Continue straight along the sample walkway.
shared-walkway.landmark: The trees and low buildings are your visual checkpoint.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder of a tree-lined campus walkway; not an APB photograph.

shared-junction.title: The meeting point
shared-junction.instruction: Pause at the sample junction and check the next direction.
shared-junction.landmark: Look for the open space where the paths meet.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder of an open campus junction; not an APB photograph.

library-turn.title: Towards the library
library-turn.instruction: Turn left at the sample building.
library-turn.landmark: Look for the illustrated library sign.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder of a library building and path; not the APB Library.

library-approach.title: The library approach
library-approach.instruction: Follow the sample path towards the public entrance.
library-approach.landmark: Check the sign beside the entrance before continuing.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder of a library approach; not an APB photograph.

library-arrival.title: Library entrance
library-arrival.instruction: Stop at the sample public library entrance.
library-arrival.landmark: In the real route, confirm that the official destination sign matches.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder of a public library entrance; not the APB Library entrance.

security-approach.title: Towards Protection Services
security-approach.instruction: Turn right towards the sample public service entrance.
security-approach.landmark: Look for a public-facing Protection Services sign in the future verified photo.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder of a public service entrance; no security interior or equipment is shown.

security-arrival.title: Public entrance / official sign
security-arrival.instruction: Stop at the sample public entrance or official sign. Do not enter restricted areas.
security-arrival.landmark: The route ends outside. Confirm the public sign in the real version.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder of a public-facing service sign; not an APB security location.

lab-turn.title: Towards the computer lab
lab-turn.instruction: Continue towards the sample learning building.
lab-turn.landmark: The selected laboratory and building will be confirmed later.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder of a learning building; not a confirmed APB laboratory.

lab-approach.title: Check the building sign
lab-approach.instruction: Follow the sample path to the public building entrance.
lab-approach.landmark: The real checkpoint must show clear public signage, with no computer screens.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder of a computer laboratory approach without people or screens.

lab-arrival.title: Computer lab checkpoint
lab-arrival.instruction: Stop at the sample lab destination sign.
lab-arrival.landmark: Building and room number are still to be confirmed.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder for a lab destination; actual room to be confirmed.

classroom-approach.title: Towards the classroom
classroom-approach.instruction: Turn towards the sample teaching building.
classroom-approach.landmark: The selected classroom and building will be confirmed later.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder of a teaching building; not a confirmed APB classroom.

classroom-arrival.title: Classroom checkpoint
classroom-arrival.instruction: Stop at the sample classroom sign and check your room.
classroom-arrival.landmark: In the real version, compare the room sign with your timetable.

image.alt: Illustrative placeholder for a classroom destination; actual room to be confirmed.

routes.summary: Try a shared walkway, a sample left turn and a library arrival checkpoint.
Try a shared walkway and a sample route ending at a public service sign.
Try shared checkpoints and a sample approach to a learning building.
Try a shared path, a sample teaching building and a classroom arrival.
